primary_scientific_computation.scope: exact orbit generation and exhaustive registered order audits only

orchestration_serialization_and_closure.scope: source materialization, canonical serialization, manifests, receipts, and closure validation

accounting.cpu_core_hours: sum of user plus system CPU seconds over the registered process tree divided by 3600
accounting.wall_clock: monotonic elapsed time from the first registered calibration or execution process until final local closure validation
accounting.peak_ram: maximum sampled sum of resident working-set bytes over the registered process tree; shared mmap pages may be conservatively double-counted
accounting.incremental_storage: maximum bytes created beneath the registered run and scratch roots, excluding immutable pre-existing source inputs and the pre-existing read-only CSR cache

claim_boundary.first_run_target: complete, replayable, and closable within one overnight 12-hour wall cap
